responsibility: Declares utility routines for writing DynamicStrings through the gm2 channel I/O subsystem. It provides one helper that emits a string unchanged and another that emits it with left padding to a requested minimum field width, serving as shared output support for numeric and text formatting modules.
same_name_distinction: This .def file only declares the shared string-output helpers for channels, while StringChan.mod contains the concrete character-by-character emission and padding loops used by other formatting modules.
